headlines.text: On a Saturday in 2023, back when FTR vs. Bullet Club Gold clashed for the AEW World Tag Team Titles in a 2 out of 3 Falls match, appearing on Collision, rated 9.47 ? an instant classic. For Bullet Club Gold, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. In a near hour-long instant classic filled with tributes to the Hart family in their hometown of Calgary, FTR outlasted Bullet Club Gold in a 2-out-of-3 falls match to retain the tag titles.

Rewind to 2026, when Kyle Fletcher vs. Komander clashed for the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.17 ? a genuinely great match. In his first defense as champion, Fletcher survived a Rope Walk Dive and a 450 splash from Komander before cutting off a Tornado DDT attempt mid-rotation with a Sheer Drop Brainbuster to retain the International Championship.

Back on this day in 2020, Cody vs. Sonny Kiss fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.21. Sonny Kiss was challenging for gold for the very first time. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2022, when Jonathan Gresham vs. Lee Moriarty fought tooth and nail for the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.74. Lee Moriarty was challenging for gold for the very first time.

Rewind to 2020, when Jon Moxley vs. Brian Cage fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.80. For Brian Cage, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
That Saturday in 2023, Ricky Starks vs. CM Punk met in an Owen Hart Tournament Final, in the night's main event on Collision, rated 6.79.
